name: Overclockers UK (UK enthusiast retailer) — Intel Arc B580 and RTX 5090 listings
notes: Complements the repo's overclockers-uk-4090-new-channel record, which covers the RTX 4090; this one covers Arc and the current GeForce flagship. All observations 2026-10-03, prices including VAT, and deliberately NOT converted to USD because no exchange rate was sourced. Arc B580: two listings visible at GBP 299.99 and GBP 319.99, both 'Out of Stock' - and note that GBP 299.99 is ABOVE the Micro Center in-store-pickup price of $309.99 for the same class of board, so the UK channel is not obviously cheaper even before shipping. RTX 5090: the only priced result was a Medion Erazer Beast 16 X1 laptop at GBP 3,899.99, cut from GBP 4,499.99, in stock - no discrete 5090 board was priced on this listing page, which is itself the finding, since it contrasts with US retail where discrete 5090 boards were priced but out of stock. A caution for anyone using this retailer as a price source: the laptop listing's own text says 'GeForce RTX 5090 GDDR7 24GB' while its title says 64GB, an internal inconsistency on the retailer's own page. Scan.co.uk was also probed for this region and refused the fetch (anti-bot), so no claim is made about it; the repo has no record covering the UK consumer channel beyond Overclockers UK and Geizhals.
